title: Structured handoff messages when external tools fail
description: When an external tool fails (login, captcha, permission, quota, timeout, DOM error), the UI shows a structured message: WHAT tool, WHAT block, WHAT evidence, WHAT human action, whether local fallback is viable.

metadata.coverage_detail: _human_external_consultation_failure classifies 7 failure types (security_verification, codex_state_missing, access_denied, session_expired, timeout, quota, generic). Each produces structured handoff with tool name, block type, evidence, human action, and local fallback mention.
metadata.p01_additions: Runtime audit trace logs blocked external tools with terminal_state and provider info.

remaining: Visual handoff for capture_unverified and wrong_thread states
unresolved: User-visible UI proof pending — requires live testing on user's Windows machine
